item.description: Hypsstratos #2446 the Twice-Born and Antimmedes #5194 the Twice-Born fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now; neither will forget.

item.title: Hypsstratos #2446 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The House of Udaeus m
item.description: Hypsstratos #2446 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The House of Udaeus made room at the fire, but no one sat close.

item.title: Ersion #9531 of the House of Pelorus fell (the stone in their midst (House of Hyperenor)).
item.description: Ersion #9531 of the House of Pelorus fell (the stone in their midst (House of Hyperenor)). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.
